newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat flat-higher gains limited by weather.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat flat-higher gains limited by weather.

text.p: CBOT wheat futures were steady to slightly higher in early trade, with most strength coming from a rally in soybean futures, traders said.
Advances in wheat were seen clipped by more favorable weather in spring wheat states and reports of good yields in hard red winter wheat areas, traders said.
Recent rains in North Dakota have boosted prospects for spring wheat production, trade sources said.
The market may be underpinned by news the Australian Bureau of Agricultural and Resource Economics (ABARE) reduced to 16.25 million tonnes its estimate for Australia's wheat production.
ABARE's previous estimate was at 19.2 million tonnes.
In early trading, LIT bought 500,000 bushels July, Cargill sold 2 million bushels July and Term Commodities sold one million July, trade sources said.
At 1057 CDT, July wheat was 3/4 cent higher $3.43-1/2 and other months were steady to 1-1/4.
